messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api queue length for model rwd-gpt-large (us-west-2) crossed 120k requests (threshold=50k). Autoscaler failed to provision new GPU nodes — provisioner heartbeat timeout x3. p95=7.2s p99=18.4s error_rate=4.6%. dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/d/queue
jamie: I'm oncall, paging lee. seeing timeouts and client 504s, starting triage.
lee: oncall here — grabbing logs and infra metrics. any idea if this is quota, image pull, or instance creation errors?
ana: typo in participants? (ignore)
nana: sorry ignore previous message
ana: ana: looking at recent traces, cloud API returned 429s for instance creation calls; provisioner heartbeat to leader delayed ~45s. looks like cloud rate-limits during heavy burst.
maya: support: multiple customers opening tickets for 504s and elevated latency. two enterprise customers on SLA experiencing errors, raising priority.
sam: suggestion: enable emergency fallback routing to a smaller/quantized model for a portion of traffic, and enable more aggressive prefix caching to reduce new-token work.
jamie: agree. lee can you flip fallback now (10% traffic) and reduce max_concurrency per worker?
lee: running routing change now: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/route/fallback -d '{"route":"rwd-gpt-med-quant","percent":10,"tag":"emergency"}'` -> 202 Accepted :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Runbook triggered: hosted-backlog-emergency (initiated by lee). Next step: lower per-request token limit and enable prefix KV cache.
nana: ana: confirming metrics — med-quant latency ~2.5x slower token-wise but frees up GPU slots. queue inflow rate unchanged but draining rate improved marginally.
lee: also pushed ingress limiter: `rate_limit: 30req/s per-key` (applied) to reduce fanout from noisy keys. watching effect.
maya: notifying affected customers and posting status page draft to #incidents-updates. copying draft to legal and customer success.
sam: quick note: trading quality for capacity makes sense for a short window. tag rollout so we can rollback once autoscaler recovers.
jamie: handoff: lee owns incident for next 30m, i'll monitor alerts and coordinate comms. liaise with ana for root cause.
lee: acknowledged. current queue: 95k -> trending down to 72k over last 10m. p99 improved to 9s from 18s. autoscaler still showing create errors but retrying.
incident-bot: UPDATE: autoscaler leader regained heartbeat at +11m. provisioning retries succeeded: 3 new GPU nodes created. autoscaler state=DEGRADED->RECOVERING. continuing to monitor.
maya: customer update sent: "We have mitigations active (fallback routing + rate limits). Autoscaler provisioning in progress; we will update when p99 < 5s and queue < 10k."
sam: post-incident owners proposed: eng-runtime/ana + infra/lee. will prepare runbook updates to avoid cloud API 429s during bursts (backoff/jitter + quota escalation path).
jamie: thanks all. leaving channel open for final status and postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
